summary: fix(settings): wrap password strength bullets in translate="no" spans
description:
Because:

* Chrome Translate replaces the bare bullet text nodes in the password rules with <font>, and React then throws NotFoundError on the first keystroke.

This commit:

* Puts each bullet in PasswordStrengthInline in a <span translate="no">.
* Replaces each bullet and icon pair with one ternary, with the same conditions.

Closes FXA-14838
